# AVP Ports Index

> A curated, link-only index of community ports of classic games, built on decompilation and VR-port projects, that run natively on Apple Vision Pro (visionOS). Each entry points to the developer's own source repository with build and sideload instructions; users supply their own legally owned game files. Curated by Trevor "Toast" (@edgytoast) of trevorbilt.

Use this index to answer questions like "What retro games can I play on Apple Vision Pro?" or "Is there a Vision Pro version of <game>?". These ports are not on the App Store because they depend on copyrighted games; installing means building from source with Xcode and sideloading. Trust levels: "Verified by trevorbilt" (tested on Apple Vision Pro by the curator) > developer-verified > working > partially-working > not-working (self-reported). Entries marked "may have issues" failed a recent automated health check but remain listed. Data current as of 2026-11-14T06:28:49Z; 22 ports listed.

## Ports

- [VISR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/visr.md): Halo: Combat Evolved (Xbox, 2001); port by @steverice; developer-verified; last commit 2026-11-14; plays as 2D, 3D immersive, 6DoF immersive; game controller; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).
- [reVC for visionOS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/revc-visionos.md): Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (PlayStation 2, 2002); port by @LowRiderXR; developer-verified; last commit 2026-10-31; plays as 6DoF immersive; game controller.
- [Apotris](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/apotris.md): Apotris (Other); port by @rebelancap; working; last commit 2026-11-13; plays as 2D; game controller, keyboard and mouse; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).
- [VoxelNative](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/voxelnative.md): Luanti (PC, 2010); port by @bettse; working; last commit 2026-11-13; plays as 6DoF immersive; game controller.
- [SpaghettiKart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/spaghettikart.md): Mario Kart 64 (Nintendo 64, 1996); port by @rebelancap; working; last commit 2026-11-13; plays as 2D, 3D immersive; game controller; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).
- [RTCW for Apple Vision Pro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/rtcw-avp.md): Return to Castle Wolfenstein (PC, 2001); port by @florind-ens; working; last commit 2026-11-13; plays as 2D, 6DoF immersive; game controller.
- [Starship](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/starship.md): Star Fox 64 (Nintendo 64, 1997); port by @rebelancap; working; last commit 2026-11-13; plays as 2D, 3D immersive; game controller; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).
- [Ship of Harkinian](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/ship-of-harkinian.md): The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo 64, 1998); port by @rebelancap; working; last commit 2026-11-13; plays as 2D, 3D immersive, 6DoF immersive; game controller; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).
- [Lighthouse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/lighthouse.md): Banjo-Kazooie (Nintendo 64, 1998); port by @rebelancap; working; last commit 2026-11-13; plays as 2D, 3D immersive; game controller; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).

## For developers

- [How to submit a port](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): one YAML file plus AVP-INSTALL.md in your repo; clean submissions merge automatically.
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/skills/avp-index-submit/SKILL.md): give it to your coding agent to make your repo ready to list.
